summary: Enhance your skills with our Green Logistics Training Course. Learn sustainable practices to optimize supply chains and reduce environmental impact.
lede: Green logistics is the management of transport, warehousing and packaging to reduce environmental impacts while balancing service, cost and resilience. This training is for professionals involved in logistics, transport, warehousing, procurement or environmental performance. It develops practical skills in building freight-emissions inventories, comparing transport modes and routes, and assessing carriers and logistics KPIs using the GHG Protocol, ISO 14083 and the GLEC Framework.
audienceIntro: Green Logistics Training is designed for professionals who influence freight, warehousing, distribution, packaging, procurement, or environmental performance. It suits foundation to intermediate learners who need a practical working method rather than advanced engineering or carbon-accounting specialization.
modules: Green Logistics Roadmaps and Leadership Reporting
prerequisites: No formal certification or coding background is required. You should have basic exposure to logistics, transport, warehousing, procurement, supply chain operations, or environmental management. Familiarity with spreadsheets is useful because exercises use structured tables, formulas, and dashboard layouts. Advanced concepts such as life-cycle assessment, AI-assisted forecasting, and automated monitoring receive conceptual or operational treatment rather than technical engineering instruction.
